authorization: Anonymous public quote; no wallet, signature, private account request or financial submission.

response_contract.gasCost: Required nonnegative Decimal in selected asset units
response_contract.tokenPrice: Optional positive USD reference price per asset unit; missing is unknown
response_contract.gasPrice_gasLimit_nativePrice: Not used to infer the gas required by a wallet transaction.

precision.decoder: Before JSON decoding, quotes numeric value lexemes outside strings; preserves escapes and structure. Guards numeric object keys so malformed JSON is not repaired into valid data. Ordinary account/catalog decoding remains unchanged.
precision.mapper: Exact monetary strings/scientific notation to Decimal; no double conversion. Accepts documented JSON numbers through lossless decoder or decimal strings; rejects missing, negative, invalid and overflow/resource-exhausting values. Zero fee accepted only when explicitly returned.
precision.api_errors: Negative numeric/string business codes classified safely by shared transport. Raw responses never shown.

ui_and_lifecycle: Withdraw asset cards provide explicit latest-fee entry. No fee requests for all visible assets or deposit cards.
Entry opens fixed market/network/asset scope and performs one anonymous initial read; manual refresh thereafter. Scope displayed with separate asset/USD units and optional reference price.
Equal queries share state; different markets/networks/assets do not share quotes. Wrong repository scope is rejected.
Thirty-second stale marker independent of refresh. Failure retains previous quote as stale; no quote remains unknown and is never fabricated as zero.
Provider and transport survive pending reads; final route release disposes them and drops late results. No automatic signing.
remaining_financial_requirements: Fee is an estimate, not final fee or authorization. Actual withdrawal must re-fetch the selected scope, enforce master-only qualification and final limits, take business/API signatures, persist submission and recover unknown outcomes.
Actual deposit, approval, withdrawal and Spot/Futures/main-subaccount transfers remain incomplete.
Current EOA as both user/signer still needs Aster acceptance; native wallet/layout/clipboard checks and iOS build remain pending by user/environment constraints.
